summary: A generic modern towed field howitzer: a long tube with a double-baffle muzzle brake, a sliding breech block… joints spin_l, spin_r, trail_l, trail_r, barrel; options paint; sockets socket_muzzle, socket_tow, socket_gunner, socket_loader, muzzle_flash.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.howitzer or place "prefab": "howitzer" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
